title: Velvety Smoked Uruguayan Vegetable Gratin
description: A charred, tender, and nostalgic Uruguayan dish featuring coriander and beurre-monte, perfect for vegetarians. This gratin is a hearty and flavorful option for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the zucchini, eggplant, and red bell pepper with olive oil, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread half of the vegetables in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a small saucepan, melt the beurre-monte over low heat.
Add the chopped coriander to the beurre-monte and stir to combine.
Pour the coriander beurre-monte mixture over the vegetables in the baking dish.
Top the vegetables with the shredded mozzarella cheese.
Add the remaining vegetables on top of the cheese.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the vegetables are tender.
